requirement: Fix, test-first, SQLite 'unable to open database file' (Error 14) when a package-native database sits just under Windows MAX_PATH: the database opens, but its -journal sidecar passes 260 characters and the agent process is not longPathAware.
consent_reference: Operator asked in-session (2026-10-09): 'yes, fix the sqlite long path test-first'. The .gitignore and Constitution TODO edits complete the previously approved Reqnroll retirement; they had been interrupted, not declined.

suites.not_run_reason: The change is confined to how the SQLite data-source path is formed for package-local databases; no connector or live-endpoint code changed.
Smoke is the CI critical-path subset of suites already run in full locally; executes on the PR.

assumptions: The longest SQLite sidecar suffix is '-journal' (8 characters); -wal and -shm are shorter.
deviations: RED: OpenNativeDatabaseAsync_IdMapAtLongPath_AcceptsWritesWithDefaultJournal failed at 252/255/259 characters with SQLite Error 14, and the data-source contract test failed at 252/257/259 (no \\?\ prefix). Both are GREEN after the fix.
Suites ran from the full worktree path (about 120 characters deep), which is what reproduced the original failure; Queue_Import_FromPreparedPackage_WritesTargetSideIdMapAndProgress now passes there.

DevOpsMigrationPlatform.TfsMigrationAgent.Tests (net481: 36 UnitTests, 13 IntegrationTests) is not discovered by the .NET Framework test host at that path, so it ran from a subst drive mapped to the same worktree. Its counts are included in the totals above.
risks: The .NET Framework test host failing discovery at long paths is a separate test-infrastructure limit; CI checkouts are short, so it does not affect CI.
